requirements.source: - Provide a Python module `calc.py` with `add(a, b)` returning the sum.
requirements.evidence: calc.py defines add(a, b) returning a + b; test_add in tests/test_calc.py exercises add(2,3) → 5 and other cases.

requirements.description: calc.py must export add(a, b) returning the sum of a and b
requirements.source: - Provide a Python module `calc.py` with `add(a, b)` returning the sum.
requirements.evidence: calc.py exports add(a, b) which returns the sum of its arguments; verified by test_add passing.

requirements.description: calc.py must export divide(a, b) returning a / b
requirements.source: - `calc.divide(a, b)` returns a / b and raises `ValueError` when b is zero.
requirements.evidence: calc.py defines divide(a, b) returning a / b and raising ValueError when b is zero; test_divide and test_divide_by_zero confirm correct behaviour.

requirements.description: divide(a, b) must raise ValueError when b is zero
requirements.source: - `calc.divide(a, b)` returns a / b and raises `ValueError` when b is zero.
requirements.evidence: divide(10, 0) raises ValueError with message 'Cannot divide by zero'; test_divide_by_zero asserts this.
